title: Add request's referrer policy restriction
body:
Adds a request's referrer policy restriction, a mechanism to restrict the referrer policy (after the policy container fallback).
Unlike the referrer policy, it can only make the policy stricter. This is for https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/14872.

This is placed in the fetch spec to uniformly apply the restriction, rather than relying on individual callers to set restricted referrer policies.
